lines: CURRENT STATE
On the ground: water
Fuel: 2 left, about 11 turns once you light it.
Here you can: feed it (3 timber), light it.
You set this down. It stays here, with whatever is
in it. You can take it up again, or hand it over
and leave it for good.
Cooking: no longer hot enough to prepare food.
HOW TO USE
Press C beside it. Feed coals with salvaged timber
(or feed to full); light it with relight coals, or
stoke to feed and light in one action. Once it
burns, dry wet gear on it. Cook raw food by
choosing cook this stack beside a fire from the
food in your pack. Press C beside it and choose
rest, or rest until a time of day: the fire keeps
burning while you sleep, and the row says how much
fuel the night takes. To take it up, move it, name
this camp or hand it over, press C beside it. Pack
up camp takes up every kit of yours within 4 cells
in one action.
Needs: to feed it: salvaged timber (each timber is
10 fuel; it holds up to 30); to light it: a flame
to light it from (a burning fire beside you, a lit
torch in your hand, or a flint striker); to rest by
it: no hostile creature within 8 cells, as for any
rest, and a lit fire with fuel enough for the night
(it burns about 0.25 fuel for every turn you rest).
Cost and limits: It burns its fuel while it is lit
and goes out when the fuel does. Taking it up puts
it out. The fuel the night burns is spent. If the
fire could not last a normal rest the row is greyed
and says what would fix it. Taking it up keeps its
contents and fuel. Handing it over leaves it
standing, and you can no longer take it up.
Right now you can: feed coals (1 salvaged timber,
up to 10 fuel), feed coals to full (3 timber, +27
fuel), relight coals from flame (1 strike, 19
left), stoke: feed 3 timber and light it (1 strike,
19 left) and 5 more. Not now: rest (The fire is
out. Light it before you settle down), rest until
Dusk (The fire is out. Light it before you settle
down).
SURFACE DETAILS
On the ground: water
water: conducts and amplifies electrical damage
while coated; dampens fire damage by 40% while
coated.
A shallow iron pan on a wire stand, made to hold a
small fire.
Type: Item
Material: Iron
